      Exploring the map

      1. Zoom in through three levels. The sculpted country shows counties, then wards rise up as you get closer, then song totems, flocks or habitat dioramas appear on the street map.
      2. Tap anything with birds. Counties, wards, totem layers and birds open details with dates and Latin names.
      3. Use the trail at the top to jump back out to a ward, county, region or the whole UK.
      4. Press play on the timeline to watch your list grow through the season.
      5. Switch to Habitat world in the menu or the view options to see every bird you've heard together in one scene.
